commentary.text: 90+6' The match has just finished.
90+4' It is time for a substitution. Christopher Rigg (Sunderland) is on for Wilson Isidor.
90+3' Will Hughes (Crystal Palace) takes the resulting corner which is well defended.

90+2' Will Hughes (Crystal Palace) decides to strike the ball towards goal, but his effort fails to threaten the goalkeeper after being blocked by one of the defenders. The ball is out of play. A goal-scoring opportunity from a corner for Crystal Palace.
90' 4 additional min. will be played.
90' Will Hughes (Crystal Palace) swings in the corner, but fails to find any of his teammates. One of the defenders reacts superbly to get it clear.

89' Daichi Kamada (Crystal Palace) hits an explosive shot from outside the penalty area and forces the goalkeeper to make a good save. The ball goes out of play and Crystal Palace have been awarded a corner kick.

89' Christantus Uche (Crystal Palace) picks up a cross inside the box and unleashes a quick shot towards the right side of the goal. His promising effort is kept out by Robin Roefs, who pulls off a stunning save!
87' Granit Xhaka (Sunderland) makes an unfair challenge by holding his opponent to prevent him from getting the ball.
86' Justin Devenny (Crystal Palace) sends a sweet pass into the penalty area, but one of the defenders averts the danger.
85' Regis Le Bris has decided to make a change. Lutsharel Geertruida (Sunderland) replaces Noah Sadiki.
84' Substitution. Christantus Uche (Crystal Palace) receives a signal from the referee and is now allowed to enter the pitch as Yeremy Pino walks off.
83' Justin Devenny (Crystal Palace) attempted to pick out a free teammate inside the box, but Robin Roefs comes off the line to clear the ball away.
81' Granit Xhaka (Sunderland) attempts to slip the ball through the defence, but is unable to find any of his teammates. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Crystal Palace.
81' Jean-Philippe Mateta (Crystal Palace) is adjudged offside.

80' What a wasted opportunity by Jean-Philippe Mateta (Crystal Palace)! He creates some space for himself inside the penalty box and unleashes a decent strike towards the middle of the net, but Robin Roefs makes a comfortable save to thwart him.
77' Yellow card! It's like Robin Roefs (Sunderland) was asking for a caution with his behaviour. Thomas Bramall agrees and books him.
76' Jean-Philippe Mateta (Crystal Palace) thinks that he is fouled by his opponent, but the referee deems him to be the one who commits a foul and awards a free kick to the other team.
74' Wilson Isidor (Sunderland) robs an opponent of the ball and explodes in anger when Thomas Bramall blows for a foul.
73' The corner from Yeremy Pino (Crystal Palace) is hurriedly cleared.

73' Daichi Kamada (Crystal Palace) shoots from the edge of the penalty area. The ball travels towards the bottom left corner, but Robin Roefs easily deals with the threat. The ball is out of play. Crystal Palace will have a chance to score from a corner.
71' Habib Diarra (Sunderland) had time and space on the edge of the box but sent his effort just over the bar.
69' Regis Le Bris has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Brian Brobbey (Sunderland) replacing Simon Adingra.
69' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Justin Devenny (Crystal Palace) is coming onto the pitch as Jefferson Lerma cannot continue after picking up an injury.
68' Marc Guehi (Crystal Palace) picks out Daichi Kamada with a fine lofted pass, but the latter wasn't able to create some space to get into shooting range.
67' Yeremy Pino (Crystal Palace) launches a cross from the corner, but Robin Roefs is alert to thwart the effort.
66' Tyrick Mitchell (Crystal Palace) tries to send a low pass into the box, but it's blocked and cleared. The ball goes out for a corner. Crystal Palace can continue in their attacking effort.
66' Yeremy Pino (Crystal Palace) sends a quick through ball into space for his teammate who is lurking close to the offside line, but one of the defenders intercepts and clears the danger.
64' Thomas Bramall couldn't ignore the rough tackle by Habib Diarra (Sunderland) and blew his whistle.
62' A cross into the box from Chemsdine Talbi (Sunderland) is cleared.
61' Jefferson Lerma (Crystal Palace) serves up a nice cross, but Robin Roefs punches the ball away.
60' Neat passing move from Sunderland in order to create new attacking opportunities.
58' Wilson Isidor (Sunderland) beats the defender to the ball in the box and shoots, but the ball flashes just wide of the right post.
57' Wilson Isidor (Sunderland) fires the ball at goal from inside the area, but it's well blocked.
55' The resulting corner, taken by Trai Hume (Sunderland), comes to nothing.

55' Wilson Isidor (Sunderland) sends a pass into the box, but the opposition's defence is alert to the danger and makes a clearance. The referee points to the corner flag and Sunderland will take a corner.
52' This corner kick is taken with a short pass by Trai Hume (Sunderland).
50' The resulting corner from Yeremy Pino (Crystal Palace) is cleared by the defence.
50' Yeremy Pino (Crystal Palace) gets to the rebound and shoots, but the effort is blocked. Crystal Palace earn a corner.
50' Jean-Philippe Mateta (Crystal Palace) came close to scoring. He connected with a pass inside the box and perhaps should have done better than direct his shot straight at Robin Roefs.
49' Daniel Munoz (Crystal Palace) tries to send the ball in front of the goal, but the opposition's defence averts the threat.
47' Jean-Philippe Mateta (Crystal Palace) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.
46' Wilson Isidor loses the ball after receiving a sweet pass from Chemsdine Talbi (Sunderland).
46' The half-time break is over and the second half is about to start.
45+5' The first half of today's match has just finished.
45+4' Rough tackle by Wilson Isidor (Sunderland). The referee blows his whistle for a foul.
45+1' Yeremy Pino (Crystal Palace) commits a rough challenge and Thomas Bramall blows his whistle for a foul.
45' There will be a minimum of 4 min. of added time.
43' Sunderland are showing great team chemistry. They are passing the ball around seamlessly.
42' Sunderland can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
42' Noah Sadiki (Sunderland) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Dean Henderson intercepts the ball.
41' What a goal-scoring opportunity! Chemsdine Talbi (Sunderland) makes a good run into the box to meet a cross and fires the ball in on goal, but the shot is amazingly blocked by a defender.
40' Habib Diarra (Sunderland) makes a rough challenge and the referee blows for a foul.
39' Will Hughes (Crystal Palace) trips an opponent with a slide tackle. Thomas Bramall stops the game and he could give him a card, but eventually decides on just a warning.
38' Chemsdine Talbi (Sunderland) attempts to find the head of one of his teammates with a promising cross into the box, but a defender outjumps the attackers and averts the threat.
37' Trai Hume (Sunderland) plays in a hopeful cross, but it doesn't find its way to any of the attacking players.
36' Yeremy Pino (Crystal Palace) spurned a good chance! He gets a shot away from inside the penalty box, but it goes inches wide of the left post.
35' Thomas Bramall interrupts the game for a tactical foul by Noah Sadiki (Sunderland).
32' The Crystal Palace players keep the ball and are exchanging a combination of passes. They are waiting for gaps in the defence to open up.
30' Yeremy Pino (Crystal Palace) requires medical treatment, so the referee stops play and signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
28' The linesman raises his flag. Simon Adingra (Sunderland) is adjudged offside.
28' Noah Sadiki (Sunderland) has picked up a minor injury, but it looks like he will be able to continue.
25' Noah Sadiki (Sunderland) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.
24' Daichi Kamada (Crystal Palace) plays a through ball but overhits it. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Sunderland.
23' Omar Alderete (Sunderland) sends a long ball in, but Dean Henderson comfortably gathers the ball.
22' Yeremy Pino (Crystal Palace) fizzes over a cross which doesn't cause any problems. The ball goes out of play and Sunderland will have a goal kick.
20' Yeremy Pino (Crystal Palace) unleashes a decent effort from just outside the box which goes narrowly wide of the left post.
19' Sunderland move the ball around well as they wait for an opportunity to shoot, but the attack is halted as they lose possession.
18' Yeremy Pino (Crystal Palace) plays a through ball which would have led to a great opportunity, if it hadn't been stopped by the defence.
16' Wilson Isidor (Sunderland) meets a cross from the flank and shoots from around the penalty spot, but the ball flies totally wide of the left post.
15' Noah Sadiki (Sunderland) wastes a huge opportunity after receiving a fine cross from the free kick, but his close-range shot goes well wide of the left post.
14' Daniel Munoz (Crystal Palace) can't expect anything else than a yellow card for his hard tackle. And a yellow it is. Thomas Bramall didn't think twice about pulling it out of his pocket.
12' Thomas Bramall blows his whistle after Yeremy Pino (Crystal Palace) kicks an opponent's legs instead of the ball.
11' Yeremy Pino (Crystal Palace) attempts to find his teammate with a short pass into the box. Daichi Kamada collects the ball, but his attack is thwarted by the defence.
9' Daniel Munoz (Crystal Palace) sends a lofted cross into the box which is headed clear.
7' Nordi Mukiele (Sunderland) shows too much aggression while trying to break free from his opponent and the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
6' Dangerous play by Will Hughes (Crystal Palace). Thomas Bramall blows his whistle for a foul.
5' Another attempt to send the ball beyond the defence by Will Hughes (Crystal Palace) is thwarted and cleared to safety.
3' Some great controlled play and passing in the middle of the pitch from Sunderland.
2' Half-chance! Chemsdine Talbi (Sunderland) plays a pass into the box, but Dean Henderson reacts well to snuff out the attack.
1' The referee blows his whistle and we are underway.
The players are out and the match is about to start. Crystal Palace will have the kick-off.
Thomas Bramall was nominated as the referee for this game.
